title: Weighted approximate tangent space at a good point of a Lusin piece (Simon Remark 3.1.8(1), pointwise)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A C : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (ϑ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (x : Amb n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet A → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) A < ∞ → IntegrableOn ϑ A (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) → MeasurableSet C → C ⊆ A → ContinuousWithinAt ϑ C x → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x P → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * (((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict A).withDensity (fun z => ‖ϑ z‖ₑ)).real ((A \ C) ∩ closedBall x ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A ϑ x P
